lines.2: 「Are you two feeling sick or something?」
lines.6: 「You both seem to be picking at your food.」
lines.7: 「That's unusual for the Princess. You normally pack it away.」
lines.8: 「Hey... Could you not be so rude?」
lines.9: 「S-Sorry. You hardly eat at all compared to Otome.」
lines.11: 「There. You're starting to sound like yourself again.」
lines.14: 「T-Tsushima, try this salmon! It's in season, so it's really good.」
lines.18: There was a subtle tension between them.
lines.20: 「Sorry this is such a modest birthday party.」
lines.21: 「No, modest is fine. I'm not the type who needs some big, flashy celebration.」
lines.22: 「Here, this is from all of us. You do a lot for us, after all.」
lines.24: 「We should've invited the Princess and Sato, too.」
lines.25: 「...I don't know. Don't things seem kind of awkward between those two right now?」
lines.26: 「What part does? They look normal to me.」
lines.27: 「Same as always. They're perfectly in sync.」
lines.31: Was I the only one who had noticed...?
lines.32: It was only the slightest tension.
lines.33: But even their conversation today had felt a little stilted.
lines.34: And whenever I talked to the Princess, Sato rushed over to join in.
lines.36: 「So, today's class representative meeting will be held as scheduled. If you're responsible, please don't forget to attend.」
lines.40: Hm? A message from the Princess?
lines.42: What for? The executive committee wasn't meeting today.
lines.44: 「I can attend meeting in Yoppi's place.」
lines.46: 「No problem, no problem. You always help me out.」
lines.51: The Princess silently gazed out at the sea.
lines.52: 「...Ever since this week started, things between you and Sato have seemed just the tiniest bit strained.」
lines.55: 「You could call it a fight, I suppose.」
lines.56: 「We made up, for now... but the real problem isn't solved, so things are still awkward.」
lines.58: 「Tsushima, I'm about to tell you something important. Listen carefully.」
lines.62: 「It seems you really are someone I need.」
lines.65: The Princess stepped right up to me.
lines.68: 「But I don't understand what you're thinking, Princess.」
lines.69: 「You suddenly dump me, then suddenly want to start over...」
lines.70: 「Are you going to dump me again?」
lines.71: 「It will be different this time. As long as you keep up with me, I won't cast you aside.」
lines.72: 「When you stopped being mine... and I saw you flirting with Yoppi... I couldn't stand it.」
lines.75: 「So I've decided you're mine after all. Now and forever.」
